newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 13 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 13 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Co. said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 13 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Berkeley USD, Calif., $20 million general obligation bonds.
--Florida Board of Administration, Fla., $7.82 million student parking bonds.
--Huntley Area Public Library, Ill., $2.4 million library GOs.
--Washington Suburban Sanitary, Md., $71.25 million water and sewer bonds.
--Hillman Community Schools, Mich., $8.345 million school building and site bonds.
--St. Paul, Minn., $7 million water refunding bonds.
--New Jersey Housing Mortgage, N.J., $200 million revenue bonds is a direct purchase.
--North Colonie CSD, N.Y., $5 million school district bonds.
--Rotterdam CSD, N.Y., $14.97 million school district bonds.
--Juniata Valley SD, Pa., $4.17 million GOs under alternate bidding.
--Wilson County, Tenn., $4.8 million capital outlay GOs.
